title: A Small Model Asks Better: Fine-Tuning Query Clarification for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.28686v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Query clarification is essential for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems that face ambiguous user queries. We consider multi-turn grounded conversational scenarios where a user query is either ill-formed or ambiguous in the context of the prior dialog or, more interestingly, it may be well-formed but when posed against retrieved documents there are multiple relevant interpretations. The task is to recognize both such cases and then generate an appropriate clarification request to the user. We present ClariEdge, a new dataset of approximately 3,900 examples that include such ambiguous queries along with negative examples that do not require clarification. We also show that a lightweight fine-tuned LoRA achieves 96.6% classification accuracy and outperforms prompted baselines of many larger models on both classification and quality of clarification generation. Our study shows that hard negatives are an essential ingredient to sepa

translated_title: 小模型问得更好：面向检索增强生成的查询澄清微调
translated_abstract: 查询澄清对于面临模糊用户查询的检索增强生成（RAG）系统至关重要。我们考虑多轮有据对话场景，其中用户查询要么在先前对话的上下文中是不完整的或有歧义的，或者更有趣的是，查询本身可能是格式规范的，但对照检索到的文档时却存在多种相关的解释。该任务需要识别这两种情况，然后向用户生成合适的澄清请求。我们提出了 ClariEdge，一个包含约 3,900 个样本的新数据集，其中包括此类歧义查询以及不需要澄清的负例样本。我们还展示了轻量级微调的 LoRA 达到了 96.6% 的分类准确率，并在分类和澄清生成质量上均优于许多更大规模的模型提示基线。我们的研究表明，困难负例是区分……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 提出了包含约3,900个样本的ClariEdge查询澄清数据集，并证明轻量级LoRA微调的小模型在分类准确率（96.6%）和澄清生成质量上均可超越许多更大模型的提示基线。
en_tdlr: Introducing ClariEdge, a ~3,900-example query clarification dataset for RAG, and showing that a lightweight fine-tuned LoRA achieves 96.6% classification accuracy, outperforming prompted baselines of much larger models.
